featured_reviews.name: Annoda Vinod
featured_reviews.review_text: We ordered from lunch from Heroti for around 7 months when we were new to the place and were setting up our home. The food was really delicious, homemade and was sufficient for 2 people. The delivery service was on time and never missed a single delivery. They have very flexible plans and are very accommodating when it comes to adjusting the dates of any meals. I would recommend their service to anyone who is looking for a healthy homely tasty meal.

featured_reviews.name: Varun Priyadarshi
featured_reviews.review_text: The best home made food that you can find in Mumbai and that too home delivered. The variety offered is simply amazing. As promised, no dish was repeated and each one of them was superb. People like us who have a hectic schedule and can't cook or order food every now and then, it is a life saver. The staff is very polite and courteous. Saw all necessary precautions taken during delivery. The food is neatly packed and is still warm after delivery. If you are missing home made food then this is the place. And it is very budget friendly.

featured_reviews.name: Prasant Tripathy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Overall service from Heroti very well justifies it's tagline.
Food tastes very good and same like home cooked food.Their on time delivery is a plus point.
Rates are very reasonable and having tried lots of other similar services in the market,I don't think so anyone is providing this kind of quality food at such rates with on time home delivery.
Please keep up the good work.

featured_reviews.name: Sunny Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: Delicious home-cooked meals that are not only tasty but also impeccably hygienic. The best part is that they are delivered fresh right to my doorstep with a warm and friendly smile. I highly recommend this service to anyone looking for a convenient and healthy meal option that doesn't compromise on flavor.

featured_reviews.name: Arpit Vyas
featured_reviews.review_text: My father is in Quarantine center and we are home quarantined so I requested these guys to supply lunch and dinner to my dad, they agreed and started delivery from the same day. The food they are providing is delicious and has very good quantity also. They are Hero's for our family - great people providing Great quality food. Keep it up guys.

featured_reviews.name: Rishabh Kale
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great home made food in your locality. The food is delicious and best suited for almost everyone in the family. I haven't found such food quality and on time delivery in Borivali atleast.
You can have a 3 day trail and then decide as well.
Thumbs up Heroti 👍.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Chandrashekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very good food and excellent service at reasonable prices, always enusred timely delivery of tiffins. No repeats of dal and vegetables in lunch and dinner over a week which is excellent in itself. More than adequate quantity of food in a meal.

They supported during our quarantine when my entire family had tested positive and no one was available to cook.
Very courteous and helpful people overall who strive to achieve customer satisfaction as thier priority.

featured_reviews.name: Shomu Seal
featured_reviews.review_text: Food is really good sometime its spicy but according ta price its good and service and timing is also good proper but sometimes they are arrogant and irritates about location and all unnecessary other wise over all its a good service and quantity is also good

featured_reviews.review_text: Highly recommended for everyone, even FOREIGNERS like me who dont eat chilly/masalas. Best Homecooked food/Tiffin services in Mumbai!!! We requested special dishes for our kid, gujarati vegetarian meals&dinner and even though we were not in Dadar at first, her delivery service was very fast and delivered the food at the door of our hotel in Marine drive & the other days wherever we were in the sightseeing tours!!! Easy communication and the food is so good that we went specially to meet her in Dadar where we enjoyed in her home, not only her food but her company and lovely family. Clean place & Anjali is like a mother outside your home!!! I cant thank you enough for everything and your hospitality.  You cant leave Mumbai without ordering from Lokhande Tiffin! We will definely come back as soon as we have holidays again!🙏🏽

featured_reviews.name: anish kadu
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently tried Lokhande Tiffin Service, and I must say, it's one of the best food experiences I've had! The food is absolutely delicious, and the level of cleanliness is impeccable. Anjali Tai, the woman behind it all, is such an amazing person. Not only does she prepare home-cooked, flavorful meals, but she also takes orders for birthday parties and small gatherings. If you're looking for tasty, fresh, and homemade food, I highly recommend visiting her service. The quality is unmatched, and you can really taste the care that goes into every dish! 😇🥰

featured_reviews.name: Radhika Rastogi
featured_reviews.review_text: Really good food, batata bhaji she makes is so tasty and non-veg is very yummy. I had booked tiffin service for my lunch in office, almost everyone loved the food in tiffin. When I had to give a arty for my birthday in office, I ordered chicken biryani, paneer veg mix and chicken curry, everyone appreciated food. She alos made few non-veg starters and we gorged on everything delightfully. It was priced reasonably and lot better than hotel food. Quantity she serves is huge portion in tiffin, enough for two people if your appetite is light. She takes party orders too.

featured_reviews.name: Amogh T.
featured_reviews.review_text:
Best tiffin service In Dadar East area. The food is really tasty and high quality and very affordable.
In one plate you get 4 chapatis, 2 sabji, dal and rice. Also variety of vegetables provided so always different taste.

Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.review_text: After trying many tiffin services over the years, I found this service to provide food which taste like home food... vegetables are good..chappatis are soft... I would recommend this to anyone who is looking for a healthy and tasty food... thanks Eager to Eat

featured_reviews.review_text:

especially children, senior citizens and people with health issues. Or if you could also include a separate meal plan keeping the above in mind, you could reach out to more customers for sure.

Thank you and all the best!

featured_reviews.name: Satyaprakash Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Delicious, home-style food that truly feels good to eat. The vegetables are fresh, tasty, and cooked perfectly, making every meal enjoyable and satisfying. Delivery is always on time, with clear and friendly communication that gives complete peace of mind. The menu is thoughtfully planned with nutritious, mindful combinations that make you feel energized and well cared for.

Thank you, Madhu Homemade Tiffin & Catering Services, for consistently delivering quality, warmth, and care through your food. I genuinely appreciate your excellent work and highly recommend your service.

featured_reviews.name: Revathi Shridhar
featured_reviews.review_text: Very delicious and hygienic home made food.  Fresh ingredients were used and the delivery was always on time. The food was prepared with love and care. Highly recommended! Thanks a ton Madhuji for the excellent service🙏🙏

featured_reviews.name: ABHAYSINGH MAHAJAN
featured_reviews.review_text:
Madhu's Homemade tiffin is really best .... taste is very good & food is healthy as well, because of less oily. Meal is easy to digest.

Quantity of one tiffin is absolutely sufficient for 1 person.
1 Sabji
4 Roti
1 Dal
1 Rice

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm regular customer of Madhu's Homemade tiffin and taking her tiffin services from last 4 months. I never experienced the quality of her food since long years in my life, which they're providing me. Her tiffin is really so hygienic with good variety of homemade food and full of taste as well. I had wonderful experienced of her delivery services on a given time slot. I really appreciate her tiffin services with full of gratitude and do recommend to everyone to try her food once. I assure you once you take her services then you'll never think to go another place for the same.

featured_reviews.name: Nilima Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently ordered from them for Ganesh Pooja and I must say I am highly impressed with their quality quantity and punctuality. All my guests praised her style of home cooked food which was exceptional compared to the outside hotel preparation.. loved every bite and was enough for the increased head count too..Thanx Madhu maam for serving us

featured_reviews.name: Adv. Ansuiya Upadhyay
featured_reviews.review_text: Ordered for my pooja ceremony for 30 people ... without Garlic onion.. The taste was yummy and super tasty .. also the quantity was quite good 👍

featured_reviews.name: NITIN REDEKAR
featured_reviews.review_text: We have been ordering food from past one year!! Such a healthy, homely and delicious food with quick home delivery by Madhu tiffin services. The quality of hygiene is amazing, quantity was sufficient and food was absolutely tasty. Hardworking and very punctual. Variety of food and absolute value for money.. we are really loving it. <3

featured_reviews.name: Noor Hudda
featured_reviews.review_text: Madhu’s homemade tiffin food tastes precisely like home-cooked food. The food was delicious, and the delivery was always on time.  The packaging and container provided are also easy to use & clean. One of the healthiest vegetarian tiffin service available in this town.
